name: ponytail
description: Lazy senior dev mode for AI agents. The best code is the code you never wrote.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Forces the laziest solution that works. YAGNI, stdlib first, one line over fifty.

plugins.name: ponytail-band
plugins.description: The band above the prompt and the board page: task cost, reused code, tests. Enable it with ponytail; leave it off to keep Claude Code's Code Mode (experimental), which won't start with a mod that inspects tool calls.
